correctness.rationale: For t>=3, the integer row determinant of observations at times n<m is a positive generalized Fibonacci number, giving uniform independent Haar pairs. The unimodular pair (x0,x1) reduces the third symbol to floor(tV-U) modulo q; exact integration gives endpoint weights 1/(2t) and interior weights 1/t. The Laurent polynomial factor (1+z^-1) sum_{0..t-1}z^j/(2t) at every qth root gives the exact iff criterion, including composite q. Haar inversion forces third signed moments of arbitrary-time binary triples to vanish. Entropy is then a direct exact consequence. The standalone exact rational area and arithmetic tests run successfully but are corroboration, not proof.
